control.description-key: Modern Dropzone component for Dynamics 365 that shows and uploads SharePoint documents for a record

property.name: allowSharePointDrops
property.description-key: Let users upload files by dropping them on the control or browsing for them.

property.name: displaySharePointDocumentLocationsControl
property.description-key: Show the picker for switching between the SharePoint document locations of the record, with options to add a location and to remember the selected one.
